proposals.title: First Stockholder Proposal
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report on unadjusted median and adjusted pay gaps across race and gender globally and/or by country, including associated risks.
proposals.evidence: We recommend that you vote against the two stockholder proposals.

proposals.title: Second Stockholder Proposal
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board evaluation and report on how it oversees risks of discrimination against individuals based on race, religion, sex, national origin, or political views in providing financial services.
proposals.evidence: we recommend a vote against the stockholder proposal.
